shots.intent: Open on a saturated, unmistakable voxel raindrop against a darker storm diorama; the subject is readable before any effect appears.

shots.beat: Sunlight enters, refracts, reflects and exits
shots.intent: Push into the authored droplet while a warm voxel light ribbon enters and two brighter contact points explain the internal path without turning the whole scene emissive.
Frame the entire droplet-plus-spectrum relationship in portrait: hero on the left, saturated color fan on the right, no clipped bands.
Move closer to the exit point only long enough to clarify the different color angles, then leave before the shot becomes static.

shots.beat: Scale from one authored droplet to many
shots.intent: Replace the hero with a smaller, cleaner field of authored cyan droplets and pull back into environment scale without filling the frame with beads.
Place the sun-break accent high in the sky, return the camera to a wide front-of-diorama position, and fit the entire thick rainbow across the portrait frame as the strongest image in the video.
